title: The Dormitories
content: I had a dream that was pretty weird, but I'll just get to the relevant point here. In my dream I was interacting with other human looking people somewhere, and when I wanted to wake up I ended in some hallway full of doorways to rooms where there were beds and occupants. I was looking for my room so I could wake up but it wasn't there. I ended up being "stuck" and lost there for a long while. Then I remembered my room was some other place and once I had it in my mind I woke up.
